ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Energy Solutions Ltd. (AESL) has secured a significant ~Rs 8,500 crore transmission project in Andhra Pradesh, crucial for integrating power to upcoming green hydrogen/ammonia projects and supporting digital infrastructure growth. This win materially boosts AESL's transmission order book to over Rs 80,000 crore and adds substantial network capacity, representing a positive operational expansion with no apparent red flags in the provided information.
